title: 2-Digit Multiplication Word Problems
intro: Connect two-digit multiplication to rectangular area.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Sketch rows of square units, then split a side length into tens and ones. Add the partial areas to explain the product.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Length: 24 feet. Width: 36 feet.

Area = length × width
24 × 36 = 864

The field covers 864 square feet.

Ask your student

What does each partial product measure in our rectangle?

If your student needs help

If the student adds the side lengths, trace the boundary and contrast it with the surface being measured.
